title: 24 Hour Metabolic Response to LPS in Monocytes
author: Brandt D Pence
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ufdeti6
materials: Aspirate Cell-Tak solution if not already done.
Data are analyzed by mean ECAR.
While plate is incubating, complete steps 16-17.

steps.title: Prepare stimulation media
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl fetal bovine serum and 50 µl pen‑strep to 4.45 ml RPMI, then sterile‑filter the mixture.

steps.title: Coat XFp plate with Cell‑Tak
steps.instruction: Prepare a Cell‑Tak solution in 0.1 M sodium bicarbonate with NaOH so that each well receives 0.56 µg Cell‑Tak (NaOH final concentration 0.63 mM). Add 25 µl to each well, incubate ≥20 min at room temperature; plates may be used immediately or aspirated, air‑dried and stored at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare monocyte suspension
steps.instruction: Isolate monocytes as described in the monocyte isolation protocol, then dilute them in the prepared stimulation media to 3 × 10⁶ cells ml⁻¹. Use the suspension immediately.

steps.title: Seed cells and centrifuge plate
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl medium to wells A and H. Add 50 µl cell suspension (1.5 × 10⁵ cells per well) to wells B‑G (run samples in duplicate or triplicate). Place the plate in the carrier and centrifuge at 300 g for 1 min without brake.

steps.title: Add stimulation medium to reach final volume
steps.instruction: Add 130 µl stimulation medium to each well A‑H, bringing the total volume in each well to 180 µl.

steps.title: Prepare LPS dilution
steps.instruction: Mix 3 µl of 1 µg ml⁻¹ LPS with 297 µl stimulation medium.

steps.title: Add media or LPS to designated wells
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl plain medium to wells A‑D and H; add 20 µl of the LPS dilution to wells E‑G.

steps.title: Incubate plate 23 h
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator and incubate for 23 hours.

steps.title: Warm up XFp analyzer
steps.instruction: Turn on the Seahorse XFp analyzer and let it warm up overnight.

steps.title: Hydrate sensor cartridge
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl XF calibration solution to each well of the sensor cartridge and 400 µl sterile PBS or H₂O to each moat. Incubate the cartridge overnight at 37 °C in a non‑CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Prepare Seahorse DMEM assay medium
steps.instruction: To 5 ml Seahorse Base Medium add 50 µl pyruvate, 50 µl L‑glutamine, and 20 µl glucose; sterile‑filter before use.

steps.title: Centrifuge plate after medium change
steps.instruction: Place the plate in the carrier and centrifuge at 300 g for 1 min without brake.

steps.title: Replace supernatant with Seahorse DMEM
steps.instruction: Aspirate the existing supernatant from each well and add 200 µl Seahorse DMEM assay medium.

steps.title: Incubate plate 1 h
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 1 hour at 37 °C in a non‑CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Clear sensor bubbles
steps.instruction: Remove the sensor cartridge from the incubator and briefly remove and re‑insert the sensors to eliminate air bubbles.

steps.title: Set up XFp assay program
steps.instruction: On the Seahorse XFp, set up the assay program, calibrate the sensor cartridge (remove lid), and configure a basal measurement block of 6 readings.

steps.title: Load cell plate into XFp
steps.instruction: After the 1‑hour incubation, remove the utility plate from the XFp and insert the cell plate (remove lid).

steps.title: Run Seahorse assay
steps.instruction: Execute the programmed Seahorse XFp assay.

steps.title: Post‑assay imaging or protein collection
steps.instruction: After the assay, image each well by photomicroscopy or collect/isolate protein from each well to normalize cell numbers.
